overall_reason: A warm ivory paper #faf9f5, a warm near-black ink #141413 and a short ladder of warm greys carry the whole interface with no accent at all, and every saturated colour on the page comes from the editorial illustrations, so each colour has a source and one role.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE, T-NEUTRALS and T-ACCENT-DOSAGE pass cleanly (no chromatic UI colour, 72 warm and 0 cool neutrals, no pure black or white); T-PALETTE-ROLES finds two text greys only a step apart, and the dark theme in the stylesheet was not captured.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.where: text levels on the #faf9f5 ground, 1440, tiles/1440-01.png card metadata and body
findings.evidence: The palette table lists four text levels at 1440: #141413 (15), #30302e (6), #3d3d3a (6) and #5e5d59 (20). #30302e and #3d3d3a sit about 0.05 apart in OKLCH lightness and are hard to tell apart on the tiles.
findings.before: Two near-identical dark greys, #30302e and #3d3d3a, as separate text levels
findings.after: Merge them into one secondary level, leaving ink, secondary and muted
findings.why: A level the reader cannot see adds a token to maintain without adding hierarchy.

strengths: The ivory paper #faf9f5, ink #141413 and warm greys hold one temperature: the table counts 72 warm and 22 untinted neutrals, 0 cool, and no pure #000 or #fff.

There is no chromatic UI colour: the area palette is 96% neutral and 0.05% chromatic at 1440, so the blue, red, green and yellow of the illustrations (tiles/1440-00.png ruler image, tiles/1440-02.png cards) read as content, not decoration.

Depth comes from lightness alone: 0 shadow recipes, 0 gradients, 0 glass; the hero carousel is a slightly darker well (#f0eee6 family) and the announcement cards are tinted panels, not shadowed boxes.
Two grounds only, the paper and the #141413 footer band; footer accordion rules are functional separators between collapsible rows.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet declares color-scheme and a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so the dark theme is not verified.
The filter: brightness(0) invert() flag in the stylesheet recolours small icons; it is not a dark-mode inversion and was not judged further.
One request was blocked (no images or fonts), so it does not affect the colour read.
